source: Report-only core, replica and file-layer measurements; excludes sqlite-wasm. Decimal units (1 MB = 1,000,000 B).
decision: Standalone apps have no bundle/WASM size limit. Measurements are informational, never a PR/CI size gate. Only the post-production Obsidian plugin has a small-bundle concern; no size experiments are requested.
history: Former ceilings provided headroom for lost-tail repair, attachments, TaskNotes views and discovery, and the generic Query cursor. The TaskNotes plugin embeds gzip-compressed WASM (~1.33x the gzip size in main.js); revisit with module splitting if app startup or plugin size measurably suffers. Targets and all other ratchets are unchanged. ONE complete launch app still includes Bases; no split or lazy launch profile is introduced.
